rationale.hitl-workflow: Defines checkpoints, bounded delegation, approvals, intervention, rollback, and human ownership.
rationale.rules-based-checks: Centers tests, linters, static analysis, sandboxes, and CI quality gates.
rationale.ai-review: Uses agents and multiple models to critique and validate generated code.
rationale.risk-routing: Audit matrix and risk models determine review depth and approval pathways.
rationale.oversight-explanation: Plans, diffs, logs, summaries, and explanations support human judgment.
rationale.agent-scope-drift: Documents mandate violations and mechanisms bounding workspace and task departure.
rationale.oversight-scaling-inversion: Accelerated generation overwhelms review, testing, integration, and operational capacity.
rationale.automation-bias: Capable developers over-trust outputs through dopamine, momentum, and apparent success.
rationale.quality-debt: Documents AI-created complexity, unreadability, bloat, coupling, and technical debt.
rationale.org-governance: Specifies organizational standards, ownership, rollout controls, roles, and accountability.
rationale.provenance-auditability: Persistent Git histories, diffs, commits, and plans enable human auditing.
rationale.framework: Provides reusable prevent-detect-correct practices across three developer-loop timescales.
rationale.survey-input: Reports substantive adoption, satisfaction, productivity, and organizational-readiness findings.
rationale.counterpoint: Opposes both brain-off automation maximalism and blanket rejection of AI coding.
rationale.assistive: Covers completions, conversational coding, and snippet-level human acceptance workflows.
rationale.agentic: Substantively addresses autonomous multi-step agents delivering artifact-scale changes.
rationale.steering: Prompting, specifications, task decomposition, and context control are major contributions.
rationale.non-developer: Includes product, design, finance, and citizen developers generating software.
rationale.risk-security: Evaluates security-review practices and AI-assisted vulnerability detection mitigations.
rationale.risk-quality: Focally analyzes maintainability, correctness, testability, complexity, and code comprehensibility.
rationale.risk-overreliance: Reports over-trust, blind acceptance, dopamine reinforcement, and weakened vigilance.
rationale.method-self-report: Authors synthesize interviews and practitioner-reported enterprise experiences.
rationale.method-mining: Git histories quantify authors’ commits, lines, branches, and productivity.
